title: D2P Unit
description: Physical unit identifier used by D2P documents. Canonical domain units are millimetres (length) and radians (angle); 'm' and 'deg' are permitted only where a schema explicitly allows them at an import/export boundary and must be converted explicitly. The root of this schema accepts any supported unit; use the $defs for narrower contexts.
$comment: Seed schema (P0). Unit conventions follow the canonical model: lengths in mm, angles in rad.

canonicalLengthUnit.title: Canonical length unit
canonicalLengthUnit.description: The only length unit permitted inside evaluated domain data (e.g. geometry snapshots).

canonicalAngleUnit.title: Canonical angle unit
canonicalAngleUnit.description: The only angle unit permitted inside evaluated domain data (e.g. geometry snapshots).
